# copyright holder

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/copyrightHolder>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent that holds a copyright ([schema:copyrightHolder](https://schema.org/copyrightHolder); [dcterms:rightsHolder](http://purl.org/dc/terms/rightsHolder)). A specialisation of [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) — the canonical rights-holder attribution. Non-functional: joint copyright has several co-equal holders.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md) from [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attribute a copyright to the agent(s) that hold it ([schema:copyrightHolder](https://schema.org/copyrightHolder), [dcterms:rightsHolder](http://purl.org/dc/terms/rightsHolder)) — the canonical rights-holder attribution, reusing [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a parallel hasHolder property (this specialises [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) by design) and avoid collapsing joint holders into one — co-equal holders coexist, so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md) agents to a [`Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) (non-functional for joint holdings); the human-readable credit line is [`gmeow:attributionText`](gmeow-attributionText.md), the structured holder is here.

### Examples

- ex:reportCopyright [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md) ex:blackcat, ex:coauthor.
